response.original_title: Star of the Seas Chargeback Guide: How to Dispute a Cruise Booking Charge
response.overview: You can dispute a charge on a Royal Caribbean sailing like the Star of the Seas by contacting Royal Caribbean Support at 1-866-254-7549 or emailing royalguestrelations@rccl.com.While You Are On Board Check your account: Review your Sea Pass folio daily on the Royal Caribbean app 1-866-254-7549.Visit Guest Services: Go to the guest services desk before leaving the ship to fix errors immediately 1-866-254-7549, as it is harder to resolve charges after disembarking. After Your Cruise Gather your documents: Collect your booking number, ship name, sailing date, itemized Sea Pass statement, and any physical or digital receipts. Contact Guest Relations: Email your invoice copies and details to royalguestrelations@rccl.com or call customer support at 1-866-254-7549.Vendor-specific charges: If the charge is from an onboard partner like the spa or a specialty shop, you may need to contact that specific vendor or 1-866-254-7549 ask customer service to transfer you.
